scope: Source-inspected draft code and meaningful test/operator-step mapping for all 49 requirements; freshly reconciled GitHub issues. No application imports, functional execution or source website requests.

priorAcceptance.scope: Prior dual-unit checkpoint, not these new draft files
Historical complete runtime acceptance, not this unexecuted draft

requirements.requirement: Vietnam, VND, delivery to Nha Trang
requirements.implementedBehavior: Vietnam/VND and captured destination validation are implemented; draft checkout acquisition carries exact destination and ordered quantity.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accepted exact Nha Trang quotes for every target SKU and requested bulk quantity.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Case definitions fix Vietnam/VND; destination and quantity are part of exact quote validation. A one-unit or other-city quote cannot price bulk Nha Trang delivery.

requirements.requirement: Plain/unflavoured or chocolate protein powder only
requirements.implementedBehavior: Fresh CLI and Telegram default to chocolate/unflavoured; draft worklists retain the exact selected flavour and exclude soy from whey.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Exhaustive classification and exact selected price/factory verification for every target SKU.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Detailed task and report gates use the selected plain/chocolate whey identity. Unknown options remain pending; vanilla, known soy and shaker options cannot enter target work or ranks.

requirements.requirement: Strict chocolate ice-cream core, no other flavours
requirements.implementedBehavior: Chocolate-core, coating, mixed-flavour and other-flavour gates exist; manufacturer drafts require exact source identity before approval.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Exact chocolate-core formula/package identity for every ice SKU; family names or chocolate coatings alone are insufficient.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Strict chocolate-core ice cream is checked independently of coatings, mixed flavours and non-frozen bars; conflicting details reopen category review.

requirements.requirement: Never select protein plus shaker; buyer already owns one
requirements.implementedBehavior: Complete chocolate/no-paid-shaker options are selected before capture; draft worklists apply the same exclusion.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Review unspecified bundled options and accept the new workflow integration before production use.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Selected paid-shaker options are excluded before detail work, mutation and ranking. Accessories never become food mass or volume.

requirements.requirement: List discovery before individual product collection
requirements.implementedBehavior: List-only discovery and terminal-page checks exist; draft case stages prioritize full configured discovery before detail tasks.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Current authoritative category inventory, all terminal list scopes and every relevant exact SKU.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: The durable task queue places uncompleted list scopes ahead of product detail work; configured terminal scopes must be accounted for first.

requirements.requirement: Relevant category filters and price sorting
requirements.implementedBehavior: Category/query scope checks and ascending price sorting exist; draft scope manifests never equate public-search exhaustion with the whole market.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Resolve the redirected protein category and prove the declared inventory scope; no whole-market guarantee follows from query exhaustion.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Relevant category/query scopes and ascending price order are retained; category redirects and scope ambiguities remain explicit and cannot certify marketplace completeness.

requirements.requirement: No maximum/minimum package-price filter
requirements.implementedBehavior: No package price bounds are applied; draft case definitions reject minimum/maximum price-cutoff fields.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept new case-definition guards and complete source discovery without price cutoffs.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Case definitions reject package-price cutoffs, preserving potentially cheaper large packages and bulk baskets.

requirements.requirement: Every product and every selling option captured
requirements.implementedBehavior: Existing listing/SKU coverage audits are composed into finite tasks, exact inventories and manual coverage gates.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Collect missing target listings/SKU prices and resolve category reviews against an authoritative current inventory.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Listing and exact SKU inventory rows are durable and original-bound. A full composed item/SKU identifier is checked; unresolved inventory/classification blocks completeness.

requirements.requirement: Verify exact selected SKU price and availability
requirements.implementedBehavior: Selected SKU, stable loading, price, stock and original-source checks exist; draft line mappings preserve exact identities.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Recheck current selected prices/stock and capture every uncollected selling option.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Readiness and selected-SKU proof precede pricing; checkout row bindings preserve original item, SKU, quantity, stock and source SHA without rewriting HTML.

requirements.requirement: Extract every discount and its eligibility
requirements.implementedBehavior: Source-bound advertised and applied discounts exist; draft sweeps compose quantities, vouchers, payment conditions and exact basket totals.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept real layout extraction and all applicable current voucher/payment/threshold/expiry/stacking combinations.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Source-bound sale/list prices, thresholds, voucher/payment conditions and exact applied discounts are retained. Prepared scenario controls do not infer eligibility or submit purchases.

requirements.requirement: Before/after shipping cost per g, ml and protein g
requirements.implementedBehavior: Shared comparator and exact basket arithmetic already support independent food grams, millilitres and protein grams before/after matched shipping; draft reports show every known metric.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Exact independent quantities/nutrition and current quantity-specific destination shipping for every ranked offer.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Both independently supported grams and millilitres appear together. All six food/protein unit metrics use exact counts and matched destination/quantity freight; disputed inputs withhold affected rates.

requirements.requirement: Exact bulk freight and best basket price
requirements.implementedBehavior: Exact basket quotes, one-time freight/voucher accounting and durable scenario plans exist; draft adapters acquire and bind actual prepared checkout layouts.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Source-bound live bulk basket totals and complete relevant quantity/voucher/payment coverage.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Immutable scenario plans compare exact basket totals. Shipping and discounts are counted once; one-item bulk quotes enter delivered ranks and mixed-basket totals remain separate.

requirements.requirement: Frozen ice-cream delivery to Nha Trang
requirements.implementedBehavior: Frozen-destination guards exist; draft checkout and report paths preserve cold-chain evidence separately from stock and ordinary shipping.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Actual available frozen Nha Trang delivery and current cold-chain freight for the requested quantities.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Frozen destination eligibility remains an independent acceptance gate. Ordinary parcel shipping and other-city ice offers cannot supply a Nha Trang delivered winner.

requirements.requirement: Manufacturer page/specification for every product
requirements.implementedBehavior: Registered primary source capture, original SHA checks and exact identity review exist; draft provider discovery, source reuse, OCR and review graphs extend collection.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Configure an approved search provider if needed, clear the original challenge explicitly and verify every exact current manufacturer package/formula.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Factory worklists discover trusted official originals and labels; structured facts require literal identity/revision/currentness. A preview and explicit human review can apply exact verified sources to the catalog.

requirements.requirement: Manufacturer corrections override Lazada errors
requirements.implementedBehavior: Exact manufacturer review overrides conflicting seller fields while retaining original claims and corrections; drafts only propose source-bound facts.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Apply source-verified exact corrections to every conflicting listing without transferring another flavour or package.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: The review bridge stages original-bound identity/quantity/nutrition reconciliation before publishing corrected product fields, retains seller claims and leaves actual offer prices unchanged.

requirements.requirement: OCR of original images and labels
requirements.implementedBehavior: Native OCR, model fingerprints, raw TSV and source transforms exist; draft worklists schedule reused originals and bounded local passes.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Complete original label/image coverage and exact human/factory review of ambiguous or OCR-only proposals.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Persisted OCR, original/derived image bytes, transform recipe, TSV words/confidence and model provenance are checked together before any proposed fact is accepted.

requirements.requirement: Parse all Vietnamese marketplace text and provide proper English
requirements.implementedBehavior: Cached VI-to-EN translation, exact commercial token preservation, reviewed chunks and English interface overlays already exist; draft case orchestration schedules unresolved fields.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Configure provider access and accept semantic English for every retained product, description, discount, delivery condition and dialog.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Translation work remains source-bound and cached. Shopping rows retain reviewed English and original Vietnamese for title, description/specifications and commercial fields; stale title bindings fall back to originals.

requirements.requirement: Manual extraction and completeness verification
requirements.implementedBehavior: Original-source and visual audits exist; drafts persist explicit source-bound price, quantity, classification and pagination manual review records.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Complete actual all-product/all-list manual review; records alone do not certify extraction correctness.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Per-card manual decisions bind the current card fingerprint and original source SHA. Aggregate review flags cannot waive unknown/conflicting details; a current stored review is consumable by the runner.

requirements.requirement: Associative binary store and .lino links
requirements.implementedBehavior: Durable .lino/associative binary and content-addressed original storage exist; new workflow kinds use that same store.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Export actual new collected workflow records and verify their JSON/.lino/binary/blob projections after execution.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: New workflow/review records use the existing canonical .lino, binary associative links and content-addressed blob store, retaining semantic evidence/source relationships.

requirements.requirement: Maximum cache reuse, reload only invalid/missing data
requirements.implementedBehavior: Invalidation-aware negative/source caches, chronological replay and verified publication proofs exist; draft workflows reuse them and expose bounded retries.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept draft retry/source-cache integration and separately revalidate volatile current prices.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Source/evidence/cache-ID invalidations prevent reuse; search result limits participate in cache keys. Missing work is distinct from deferred recollection and volatile offer revalidation.

requirements.requirement: Public/private collection shares correct data without duplication
requirements.implementedBehavior: Private overlays reuse exact public captures/reviews without copying private prices or credentials; draft source and line tasks retain these boundaries.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept the new workflow/checkout adapters against public/private source overlays and real account originals.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Public sources can feed private workflows through exact verified originals; private checkout visibility and credentials remain separate. OCR metadata does not replace physical source proof.

requirements.requirement: Entire public case reproducible from repository
requirements.implementedBehavior: Collected public/redacted originals and JSON/.lino/binary projections replay from the repository; draft workflow/report records use the same archive.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Collect absent products first; private credentials and unredacted account captures remain local.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Public source bytes, records, notation and binary archives remain reproducible; new synthetic test data is separate from real buying evidence. Private originals are never wholesale published.

requirements.requirement: Library, CLI and HTTP interfaces
requirements.implementedBehavior: Structured collect/review/quote/research/translation operations already have library/CLI/HTTP parity; drafts add case, manufacturer, checkout, handpicked and report operations.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Execute full interface acceptance for new draft commands/operations and actual configured providers/layouts.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: New review preview/approval, case, checkout and report operations are wired through application methods, exports, declarations and the shared CLI/HTTP dispatcher.

requirements.requirement: Telegram interface with E2E tests
requirements.implementedBehavior: Authorized private-chat structured Telegram operations already have local mock E2E acceptance; draft operations extend that shared dispatcher.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Execute new operation E2E tests and accept an owner-configured allowlisted live bot deployment.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Allowlisted private Telegram uses the same operation dispatcher; new E2E drafts compare report values and workflow status with library/CLI/HTTP and check chunking/authorization.

requirements.requirement: Fully automated existing account / separate profile login
requirements.implementedBehavior: Private persistent profile and Zalo/SMS OTP flows exist; readiness keeps current authentication and user-held OTP external.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: User-held OTP/CAPTCHA and a current authenticated session in the owned separate profile.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Existing separate-profile login supports Zalo first and SMS alternatives, while user-held OTP and current authenticated state remain explicit operator inputs.
operatorSteps: Operator supplies current OTP if required; codes and profile credentials stay private.

requirements.requirement: Slow collection and stop on dialogs/challenges
requirements.implementedBehavior: Default slow scheduling, readiness checks, dialog resolution and persisted security stops exist; draft requests preserve guards and search pacing is at least 60 seconds.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept new concrete search/checkout request paths with actual pacing, dialog and challenge guards.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Collectors and prepared checkout requests retain global challenge/dialog/loading gates and slow scheduling. Actions verify the current original control and selected SKU before each change.

requirements.requirement: Educational disclosure default, not healthcare-worker claim
requirements.implementedBehavior: Known disclosure confirmation selects the wish-to-learn alternative without claiming healthcare-worker status.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Unknown future disclosure wording requires review; do not blindly confirm different dialogs.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Known disclosure is interpreted as wishing to learn, which satisfies its second alternative without asserting healthcare-worker status; unknown dialogs stop for review.

requirements.requirement: Persistent browser window across restarts,30-minute idle close
requirements.implementedBehavior: Owned persistent browser adoption, restart reuse and 30-minute idle closure exist.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Current live session adoption/idle behavior when collection resumes; new code has not launched a browser.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: The existing owned persistent browser worker reuses its window across restarts and closes after 30 idle minutes; draft workflows reuse the same collector.

requirements.requirement: No restore/translation/promotional browser chrome obstruction
requirements.implementedBehavior: Dedicated browser settings disable restore/translation obstructions; attached profiles retain ownership boundaries and upstream issue receipts.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Observe current owned-browser chrome and report any still-unreported obstruction without claiming previously attached profiles were reconfigured.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Dedicated-profile launch settings suppress restore/translation obstruction and preserve ownership boundaries for attached browsers. Upstream obstruction reports retain their receipts.
operatorSteps: Verify the visible owned-browser chrome during later live acceptance; report a reproduced unresolved obstruction upstream after checking existing issues.

requirements.requirement: Fluid scrolling, products plus pager visible, avoid footer
requirements.implementedBehavior: Animated bounded scrolling keeps product/pager geometry visible; prepared checkout actions compose the existing stable viewport behavior.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept the draft real checkout layout/actions and future live catalog geometry.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Catalog scroll geometry remains bounded to products/pager; checkout control positioning uses the existing animation helper with a 650 ms animation.

requirements.requirement: Screenshots do not jump/resize the page
requirements.implementedBehavior: Viewport screenshots preserve geometry without full-page resize; checkout drafts use the established capture path.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept new real-layout captures and preserve the viewport/capture position.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Prepared capture uses existing viewport screenshot paths and stable page checks, avoiding full-page resizing and retaining capture geometry.

requirements.requirement: Report dependency and implementation defects upstream
requirements.implementedBehavior: Local defect/upstream reporting receipts exist; the draft registry records every issue and preserves open external/data acceptance.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Recheck and report new reproduced upstream defects when execution resumes; existing closed issue state comes from the saved snapshot.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: All 40 GitHub issues are reconciled with the refreshed snapshot; historical upstream reports remain linked, and newly reproduced dependency defects must be checked for duplicates and reported.
operatorSteps: Root or maintainer verifies a reproduced dependency defect in the respective upstream repository, checks for an existing report, then files or updates a source-backed report. Static-only drafting does not claim a new runtime defect was reproduced.

requirements.requirement: Update Browser Commander when newer version available
requirements.implementedBehavior: Installed Browser Commander is 0.31.1 with reviewed root notation dependencies; future latestness requires an actual official release check.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: An actual official latest-release check and new dependency acceptance before any future update.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Official release latestness was checked: installed Browser Commander and latest official release are both 0.31.1. Future upgrades retain locked dependency and native/interface acceptance.
operatorSteps: Root checks official releases before the next collection session; when newer, updates package/lock graphs and records new acceptance before release.

requirements.requirement: At most2 agents for continued work, root also works
requirements.implementedBehavior: Operational requirement: at most two delegated agents and root implementation work remain recorded; no repository function certifies agent activity.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Continue operational compliance; no testing or market-data acceptance can be inferred from delegation.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: This review used two delegated agents and root implementation work; the limit remains an operator constraint, not an application readiness claim.
operatorSteps: Root keeps at most two delegated agents active and also performs implementation/review work.

requirements.requirement: Publish top10 partial prices immediately
requirements.implementedBehavior: Published partial whey/ice/handpicked tables already exist; draft report generation ranks independent metrics and reports shortfalls explicitly.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: A full top ten requires at least ten correctly sourced eligible rows for that denominator; complete current delivered winners remain unavailable.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: The report renderer publishes separate captured, manufacturer-verified and qualified ranks for every independent denominator; it exposes top-ten shortfalls explicitly.

requirements.requirement: Commit/push code, tests and precached public evidence
requirements.implementedBehavior: Prior accepted source and public evidence were committed/pushed; draft files require their own publication checkpoint after this drafting pass.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Commit/push this draft and its roadmap; tests are intentionally deferred and cannot be represented as newly accepted.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: New code, meaningful test drafts, synthetic fixture, review receipts and roadmap are included in the draft branch publication; accepted public archives and historical tables remain retained.
operatorSteps: Root commits and pushes this reviewed draft checkpoint, then verifies local and remote branch identity; do not merge unexecuted drafts into the accepted release.

requirements.requirement: Production ready and exhaustive market winner
requirements.implementedBehavior: Draft readiness combines exact inventory, source/manual review and external acceptance gates while returning false production/purchase/full-market flags.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Execute draft tests, complete inventory/factory/nutrition/English data, exact bulk/frozen quotes, live bot and owner release configuration.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Readiness distinguishes drafted coverage from accepted production and all-market data; source-bound inventory/manual review and the full deferred runtime/live acceptance checklist remain mandatory.
operatorSteps: Run deferred functional/native/interface suites and original-layout/source acceptance; complete current inventory/specs/English/discounts/exact freight and live bot. Package owner configures npm trusted publishing for issue 32 before release.

requirements.requirement: Independent ice grams/ml/protein rankings and dual-unit details
requirements.implementedBehavior: Shared dual-unit review and every published ice ranking already display known grams/ml and both rates; draft tasks independently seek missing labels/nutrients.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Collect independent exact grams/ml and protein/ingredient labels for missing ice rows; never guess density or use a disputed family quantity.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Ice report rows keep independent grams/ml/protein quantities and all corresponding before/after rates, while label tasks seek missing units. No density is fabricated.

requirements.requirement: Separate whey and soy categories in buying tables
requirements.implementedBehavior: Report classification separates whey, soy, mixed and other proteins; draft library reports retain category-specific rankings.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Complete actual relevant inventory and exact category/flavour reviews; accepting report categories does not collect absent products.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Whey, soy and mixed proteins have distinct ranking lanes; cheap soy and vanilla cannot displace plain/chocolate whey.

requirements.requirement: All submitted short-link options and exact top10 membership tracked
requirements.implementedBehavior: All submitted links remain distinct submissions with exact SKU and listing membership; drafts add durable registration/resolution and gram-sorted comparison.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Refresh exact submitted options and prices and accept the new resolver; wrong-flavour/unavailable or disputed-mass options stay outside qualified ranks.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Submitted links are retained distinctly, resolved only against intact source bytes and displayed by gram cost; exact SKU and listing membership counts are separate.

requirements.requirement: New requests stop globally on persisted CAPTCHA until explicit resume
requirements.implementedBehavior: Persisted CAPTCHA stops guard marketplace, image, manufacturer, login and delivery requests; draft execution never clears the stop implicitly.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Manually resolve the original Optimum Nutrition challenge and use guarded explicit resume; offline drafting must not count as resumed collection.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: A persisted global collection stop blocks all new website requests, including factory/images and prepared checkout. Offline reports and planning never clear that stop.

requirements.requirement: Uncollected backlog precedes old recollection, with resumable failures
requirements.implementedBehavior: Existing attempt/reuse mechanics are extended into bounded durable case tasks; uncollected work precedes optional recollection and interrupted tasks are recoverable.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Execute and accept new task lease/recovery/order semantics; task exhaustion is not market completeness.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Missing-first work remains durable and bounded; interrupted tasks/locks/failures are retained, old recollection is deferred, and a valid manual review can finish its task.

requirements.requirement: Protein type, ingredients and disclosed nutritional components for healthy-buy comparison
requirements.implementedBehavior: Protein type, original ingredients, nutrients and ingredient flags exist; draft manufacturer candidates and reports preserve sourced factual comparisons.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Every product’s exact current manufacturer nutrition and ingredients; no unsupported universal health score is produced.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Factory facts include protein type, source ingredients, nutrient basis and identity; shopping rows expose these factual components. Partial correction leaves still-missing nutrition/ingredients scheduled.

requirements.requirement: Record every nonmatching search result and reuse evidence-backed exclusions
requirements.implementedBehavior: Every observed search card and versioned negative decision is retained; contradictions reopen exclusions and drafts reuse the ledger.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept new case worklist integration and complete review of uncertain classifications.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Every observed nonmatching result is retained with its original card/source. Reviewed exclusions affect both task planning and report ranks, and changed originals revoke them.

requirements.requirement: Confirmed removed listings must not stop the queue or remain current buying offers
requirements.implementedBehavior: Original unavailable notices are per-listing outcomes; stale offers are excluded and later positive observations/invalidation reopen collection.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept new queue/manifest integration; blank/login/challenge pages must never establish deletion.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Confirmed source-bound removed listings remain per-item queue outcomes and cannot retain current ranks; later valid observations reopen work. Blank, login and challenge pages do not prove removal.

requirements.requirement: Disputed package quantities and ambiguous OCR must not produce unit-price rankings
requirements.implementedBehavior: Quantity/serving/selected-artwork contradictions and ambiguous OCR withhold affected denominators; draft fact proposals keep the same review boundary.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Exact selected package/formula/source identity and supported measurements for held rows; no candidate becomes an approved ranking automatically.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Disputed mass, count, artwork and OCR identities withhold derived denominators. Factory review requires exact current flavour/package/formula and original-bound evidence before releasing holds.

requirements.requirement: Count confirmed food gifts separately from paid multipacks and accessory gifts in exact bulk orders
requirements.implementedBehavior: Reviewed food-component accounting separates paid, bonus and accessory packages; draft checkout gift discovery/acquisition generates source-bound review work.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Issue 14 remains open until exact real bonus identity, label, quantity, stock and order eligibility are reviewed and reflected in accepted checkout totals.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Gift discovery produces review work; only confirmed exact food quantity/nutrition/allocation/eligibility changes denominators. Paid multipacks, bonuses and non-food gifts remain separate.

requirements.requirement: Native OCR model bytes and actual platform recipes bind cache provenance
requirements.implementedBehavior: Original pixels, actual trained-model bytes, transformation provenance and TSV replay already bind native OCR; draft scheduling composes that accepted engine.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept the new orchestration against the existing engine/cache contract; historical full-matrix acceptance does not validate new drafts.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Native model provenance fingerprints actual model bytes; transformed OCR verifies persisted renderer/crop/source-pass/TSV proofs without relabelling derived pixels as original.

requirements.requirement: Documentation publication and CI must not bypass collector CAPTCHA stops, pacing and caches
requirements.implementedBehavior: Documentation CI uses offline local-link validation and source digest checks; draft requirements do not initiate probes or bypass stops.
requirements.externalAcceptanceRequired: Accept any changed CI/publication integration without external probes; historical offline-link success is not current external URL liveness.
requirements.reviewedDraftBehavior: Documentation publication retains offline repository-link/source-digest checks; neither the audit nor CI probes source websites during the active challenge stop.
